description: Minified JavaScript bundle for Bootstrap v3.3.5, including core plugins for transitions, alerts, buttons, carousel, collapse, dropdown, modal, tooltip, popover, scrollspy, tab, and affix. It handles DOM manipulation, event binding, UI component behaviors, and feature detection. The file requires jQuery and extends it with Bootstrap's plugin functionalities.

methods.name: emulateTransitionEnd
methods.description: Simulates the end of a CSS transition after a specified duration for jQuery elements.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Handles dismissing alert boxes with fade-out animation.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the button state (e.g., loading) by changing its text and state.

methods.name: cycle
methods.description: Starts the carousel auto-cycling with specified interval.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays modal dialog, handling focus and backdrop.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides modal dialog, removing classes and handling backdrop.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles UI components such as modals, tooltips, or collapse panels.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays tooltip or popover with positioning.

methods.name: addAriaAndCollapsedClass(a,b)
methods.description: Sets ARIA attributes and collapsed classes for accessibility.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of an element for tooltip/popover placement.
